description.zh: 授权结束日期，合约型方案不能为空，类型：yyyy-MM-dd。
description.en: The authorization end date. This field is required for contract-based plans. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

description.zh: 授权场景ID。您可在**号码认证服务控制台**的**授权场景管理**页面查看授权场景ID。
description.en: The authorization scenario ID. You can view the authorization scenario ID on the **Authorization Scenarios** page in the **Phone Number Verification Service console**.

descriptions.zh:
### 准备工作
请先完成阿里云账号注册、获取阿里云访问密钥，更多信息，请参见[通信授权服务使用流程](~~196922~~)。
### QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为1000次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
### Preparations

Register an Alibaba Cloud account and obtain an AccessKey pair. For more information, see [Communication Authorization Service workflow](~~196922~~).

### QPS limit

The per-user QPS limit for this operation is 1,000 calls per second. Exceeding this limit triggers rate limiting, which may affect your business. Call this operation only as needed.
